title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Integrating artificial intelligence and molecular simulation for peptide discovery: limitations, validation and decision-centered workflows
items.abstract_or_text: Summary. Therapeutic peptides occupy a chemical and pharmacological space between smallmolecules and biologics, offering extended recognition surfaces and access to targets that resist conventionalmodalities. Their discovery, however, requires the simultaneous optimization of activity, selectivity, stability, permeability and synthetic feasibility across a conformationally complex and chemically heterogeneous search space. Artificial intelligence (AI) andmolecular simulation address complementary aspects of this problem: AI learns structure–property relationships and explores large candidate libraries, whereas simulation interrogates conformational ensembles, target recognition and membrane-associated behaviour within an explicit physical model. We organize the field around a single, more discriminating question: under which chemical, biological and decision-making conditions does adding molecular simulation to an AI workflow improve peptide discovery outcomes enough to justify its cost? To answer it, we introduce a decision framework linking peptide chemistry and discovery endpoint to the decision beingmade, the uncertainty limiting that decision, the evidence that computation or experiment can provide, the cost of obtaining that evidence and the criterion for proceeding or stopping. Recent advances in biomolecular structure prediction, protein language models, generative design andmacrocycle engineering supply powerful enabling capabilities, but their transfer to short, flexible, cyclic and chemically modified peptides remains unevenly validated. Critically, a structured survey of 15 integrated studies shows that none (0 of 15) included a matched-budget comparison against an AI-only or conventional baseline, a scarcity we treat as a central empirical finding rather than an inconvenience. We outline reporting, benchmarking and prospective-validation standards by which genuine progress should be judged, and define what ‘developable’ must mean at the hit, lead and candidate stages.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出以“决策—不确定性—证据—成本—推进/停止准则”为核心的框架，审视何时将分子模拟加入 AI 肽发现流程真正值得其成本。作者系统梳理 15 项整合研究，指出没有一项进行了与 AI-only 或传统基线相同预算下的比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将焦点从模型能力转向可开发肽药的决策证据，并明确了报告、基准测试和前瞻验证的缺口。其结论主要来自结构化综述而非新的湿实验；短肽、环肽和化学修饰肽上的迁移性仍缺乏充分验证。
items.abstract_zh: 治疗性肽处于小分子与生物制剂之间的化学和药理学空间，提供更大的识别表面，并可作用于常规模式难以处理的靶点。然而，其发现要求在构象复杂且化学异质的搜索空间中，同时优化活性、选择性、稳定性、渗透性和合成可行性。人工智能（AI）与分子模拟解决这一问题的互补方面：AI 学习结构—性质关系并探索大型候选库，而模拟在显式物理模型中考察构象集合、靶标识别和膜相关行为。我们围绕一个更具判别力的问题组织该领域：在何种化学、生物学和决策条件下，向 AI 工作流加入分子模拟所带来的肽发现结果改进，足以证明其成本合理？为回答这一问题，我们引入一个决策框架，将肽化学和发现终点与所要作出的决策、限制该决策的不确定性、计算或实验可提供的证据、获得该证据的成本以及继续或停止的准则联系起来。生物分子结构预测、蛋白质语言模型、生成式设计和大环工程的近期进展提供了强大的赋能能力，但它们向短肽、柔性肽、环肽和化学修饰肽的迁移仍未得到均衡验证。关键的是，对 15 项整合研究的结构化调查显示，没有一项（15 项中 0 项）纳入与 AI-only 或传统基线相匹配预算的比较；我们将这种稀缺视为一项核心实证发现，而非不便之处。我们概述了用于判断真实进展的报告、基准测试和前瞻验证标准，并界定在命中物、先导物和候选物阶段“可开发”必须意味着什么。

items.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Protein Language Models for Dual-Target Antimicrobial Peptide Discovery Under Strict Homology Constraints
items.abstract_or_text: The worldwide escalation of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) poses a severe challenge to modern public health, necessitating novel classes of therapeutic agents. Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) represent highly promising alternatives to small-molecule antibiotics due to their co-evolutionary resilience and rapid membrane disruption dynamics. However, translating computational AMP leads into clinical drug candidates remains bottlenecked by off-target cytotoxicity, predominantly hemolytic activity against mammalian erythrocytes. Although pretrained foundational protein language models (PLMs) have rapidly advanced molecular property prediction, current architectures frequently isolate antibacterial potency and cytotoxicity into disconnected single-task pipelines or succumb to catastrophic performance drops under strict homology-controlled evaluations. Recently, the Quantitative Mapping of Antimicrobial Peptides (QMAP) benchmark proposed that frozen PLM embeddings show weak linearly accessible features for hemolytic activity (HC50) resulting in poor rank correlation ({rho} < 0.25) on out-of-distribution sequence splits. In this work, we introduce an end-to-end multi-task parameter-efficient transfer learning framework designed to simultaneously optimize antibacterial potency and minimize mammalian cytotoxicity without sequence leakage. Built upon ESM-2 (150M), our architecture incorporates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into self-attention projections, fine-tuning approx 0.70% of model weights. To restore gradient interference originating from disparate membrane lysis mechanisms, we implement an adaptive multi-task loss guided by Kendall homoscedastic uncertainty weighting. Evaluated across predefined QMAP benchmark splits enforcing a 60% maximal sequence identity threshold, our joint architecture remarkably outperforms conventional linear probes, tree-based regressors, and frozen foundational models. The framework achieves an E. coli potency rank correlation of {rho} = 0.6132 (r = 0.6816) and successfully elevates hemolytic toxicity correlation to {rho} = 0.5374 (r = 0.5541). To establish real world utility, we deploy the optimized joint network to screen a curated in silico library of 749 de-novo designed peptides, successfully isolating selective cationic-amphipathic candidates possessing Therapeutic Indices (TI = HC50/MIC) up to 144.03 while effectively deprioritizing broadly lytic motifs (TI < 2.0). These findings demonstrate that parameter-efficient adaptation unlocks fine-grained bioactive structural semantics in foundational PLMs, providing an accurate, scalable framework for therapeutic peptide engineering.
items.summary_zh: 研究在 ESM-2 (150M) 上以 LoRA 微调约 0.70% 参数，并以不确定性加权多任务损失同时预测抗菌效力和溶血毒性。在 QMAP 的最大序列同一性 60% 切分中，模型的 E. coli 效力 Spearman ρ 为 0.6132，溶血毒性 ρ 为 0.5374；对 749 条从头设计肽的虚拟筛选获得最高 144.03 的治疗指数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作以严格同源性控制评估多目标 AMP 设计，直面效力与安全性难以兼顾的问题。证据仍以基准和虚拟筛选为主，候选肽的体外活性、溶血性及体内可开发性尚待实验证实。
items.abstract_zh: 全球抗微生物药物耐药性（AMR）的加剧对现代公共卫生构成严峻挑战，亟需新类别的治疗药物。由于具有共同进化韧性和快速膜破坏动力学，抗菌肽（AMP）是小分子抗生素极具前景的替代品。然而，将计算 AMP 先导物转化为临床候选药物仍受制于脱靶细胞毒性，主要是对哺乳动物红细胞的溶血活性。尽管预训练基础蛋白质语言模型（PLM）已快速推动分子性质预测，现有架构经常将抗菌效力和细胞毒性拆分为彼此断开的单任务流程，或在严格同源性控制评估下出现灾难性性能下降。近期，抗菌肽定量映射（QMAP）基准提出，冻结的 PLM 嵌入对溶血活性（HC50）仅呈现较弱的线性可访问信息，在分布外序列切分上的秩相关性较差（ρ < 0.25）。在本工作中，我们提出一个端到端、多任务、参数高效的迁移学习框架，旨在同时优化抗菌效力并最小化哺乳动物细胞毒性，同时避免序列泄漏。基于 ESM-2 (150M)，我们的架构将低秩适配（LoRA）引入自注意力投影，微调约 0.70% 的模型权重。为恢复由不同膜裂解机制引起的梯度干扰，我们实现了由 Kendall 同方差不确定性加权引导的自适应多任务损失。在预先定义的、执行最大序列同一性阈值为 60% 的 QMAP 基准切分上评估时，我们的联合架构显著优于传统线性探针、树模型回归器和冻结基础模型。该框架获得 E. coli 效力秩相关性 ρ = 0.6132（r = 0.6816），并成功将溶血毒性相关性提高至 ρ = 0.5374（r = 0.5541）。为建立现实世界效用，我们部署优化后的联合网络，对包含 749 条从头设计肽的精选虚拟文库进行筛选，成功分离出具有选择性的阳离子两亲性候选物，其治疗指数（TI = HC50/MIC）最高达 144.03，同时有效降低广泛裂解基序（TI < 2.0）的优先级。这些发现表明，参数高效适配可解锁基础 PLM 中精细的生物活性结构语义，为治疗性肽工程提供准确且可扩展的框架。

items.title: Bridging the Literature-to-Laboratory Gap with Language Models and Active Learning for Reaction Feasibility Prediction and Autonomous Exploration
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting reaction feasibility is essential to organic synthesis, yet models trained on literature records often fail to generalize to laboratory data. Here, we present a two-stage distillation and adaptation framework that transfers reactivity knowledge from large, noisy literature datasets to small, controlled high-throughput experimentation (HTE) datasets, and further leverages this transferable knowledge to enable uncertainty-guided active learning. Literature reactions are curated and augmented with chemical reasoning to post-train reaction-specific language models through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), producing a compact generalist model. In zero-shot evaluation across Suzuki–Miyaura coupling, Buchwald–Hartwig amination and acid–amine condensation, the generalist model outperforms the strongest baseline by 41.5% in mean accuracy and 29.2% in macro-F1, while surpassing human expert accuracy by 8.9% and macro-F1 by 11.5%. To accelerate active exploration, generalist predictions are transferred into warm priors for Bayesian neural networks. This warm prior reduces the experimental labels needed to reach a held-out macro-F1 ≥ 0.70 by 25.0–42.9% relative to a vanilla Bayesian neural network (BNN). Furthermore, uncertainty-guided acquisition prioritizes informative reactions, enabling the models to approach full-pool training performance using only about oneeighth of the total available reactions. To our knowledge, this work establishes the first experimentally validated literature-to-laboratory paradigm connecting 1 large-scale post-trained language models with active experimental design, providing a practical foundation for data-efficient, privacy-preserving, and autonomous chemical discovery.
items.summary_zh: 该研究将经化学推理整理和增强的文献反应知识蒸馏到紧凑语言模型，再作为贝叶斯神经网络的 warm prior，用不确定性引导主动学习。其在 Suzuki–Miyaura 偶联、Buchwald–Hartwig 胺化和酸—胺缩合的零样本测试中优于最强基线，并降低达到 macro-F1 ≥ 0.70 所需的实验标签数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它尝试连接文献数据与受控 HTE 实验，并将反应语言模型置于主动实验设计闭环中，具有自动化合成探索价值。结果目前限于三类反应和所用 HTE 数据；跨反应家族、实验室条件及真实自主系统的泛化仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 预测反应可行性对有机合成至关重要，但在文献记录上训练的模型往往无法泛化至实验室数据。在此，我们提出一个两阶段蒸馏与适配框架，将来自大型、含噪文献数据集的反应性知识迁移至小型、受控的高通量实验（HTE）数据集，并进一步利用这种可迁移知识实现不确定性引导的主动学习。文献反应经过整理并以化学推理增强，通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）对反应特异性语言模型进行后训练，产生一个紧凑的通才模型。在 Suzuki–Miyaura 偶联、Buchwald–Hartwig 胺化和酸—胺缩合的零样本评估中，该通才模型在平均准确率上比最强基线高 41.5%，在 macro-F1 上高 29.2%，并且比人类专家准确率高 8.9%、macro-F1 高 11.5%。为加速主动探索，通才模型的预测被迁移为贝叶斯神经网络的 warm prior。相较于普通贝叶斯神经网络（BNN），该 warm prior 将达到留出集 macro-F1 ≥ 0.70 所需的实验标签数减少 25.0–42.9%。此外，不确定性引导的获取策略优先选择信息量大的反应，使模型仅使用总可用反应数约八分之一便能接近全池训练性能。据我们所知，本工作建立了首个经实验验证的“文献到实验室”范式，将大规模后训练语言模型与主动实验设计相连接，为数据高效、保护隐私和自主化学发现提供了实用基础。
items.author_line: Haowen Zhong, Yi Yang, Jiekai Jia, Xin Yan, Yongli Xie, Yuan Li, Xiaofeng Cui, Sen Lin, Peng Wang, Xiaoxue Wang

items.title: RangeFinder: Predicting Ligand Property Ranges from Protein Pockets
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying ligands for a protein target requires searching a vast chemical space for a comparatively small set of compatible molecules. Existing machine learning approaches primarily address this problem by generating candidate ligands or scoring individual protein-ligand pairs, but provide limited information about the broader chemical space compatible with a binding pocket. We introduce RangeFinder, an SE(3)-equivariant transformer pocket-level model, trained and evaluated on BioLiP2 data, that predicts ranges over nine physicochemical ligand properties directly from pocket structure, chemistry, and evolutionary context. Using an intersection-over-union objective and evaluation metric (range-IoU), RangeFinder achieves a range-IoU of 0.464 \pm 0.002, outperforming all deployable baselines while requiring only 12.2 ms per pocket. We also quantify our method's ability to reduce the ligand search space while retaining compatible binders; in this regard, RangeFinder achieves a Reduction-Recall F-Score of 0.543 \pm 0.011 --- once again outperforming all deployable baselines. Ablation experiments indicate that RangeFinder's performance depends more strongly on the density and quality of ligand supervision than on any individual input modality or specialized training strategy. Together, these results position RangeFinder as an inexpensive and effective molecular filtering prior, with demonstrated potential in narrowing the ligand search space of target pockets before docking, generation, or synthesis. The code for this project can be found at: https://github.com/alannadels/RangeFinder.
items.summary_zh: RangeFinder 是一个 SE(3)-等变 transformer，直接从蛋白口袋的结构、化学和进化背景预测 9 项配体理化性质的范围。在 BioLiP2 上，模型取得 range-IoU 0.464 ± 0.002 和 Reduction-Recall F-Score 0.543 ± 0.011，单个口袋推理仅需 12.2 ms。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 与直接生成或逐对打分不同，这一方法将口袋可容纳的化学空间作为可计算的筛选先验，可用于对接、生成或合成前缩小搜索范围。其标签质量和密度是主要性能决定因素，且尚未显示对实际命中发现的前瞻性增益。
items.abstract_zh: 为蛋白质靶标识别配体，需要在巨大的化学空间中搜索相对少量的兼容分子。现有机器学习方法主要通过生成候选配体或对单个蛋白质—配体对进行评分来解决这一问题，但对与结合口袋兼容的更广泛化学空间提供的信息有限。我们引入 RangeFinder：一种口袋层面的 SE(3)-等变 transformer 模型，在 BioLiP2 数据上训练和评估，直接从口袋结构、化学和进化背景预测九项配体理化性质的范围。使用交并比目标和评估指标（range-IoU），RangeFinder 达到 0.464 ± 0.002 的 range-IoU，优于所有可部署基线，同时每个口袋仅需 12.2 ms。我们还量化了该方法在保留兼容结合物的同时缩小配体搜索空间的能力；在这方面，RangeFinder 获得 0.543 ± 0.011 的 Reduction-Recall F-Score，再次优于所有可部署基线。消融实验表明，RangeFinder 的性能更强地依赖于配体监督的密度和质量，而非任一单独输入模态或专门训练策略。总体而言，这些结果将 RangeFinder 定位为一种低成本且有效的分子过滤先验，显示出在对接、生成或合成之前缩小靶标口袋配体搜索空间的潜力。该项目代码见：https://github.com/alannadels/RangeFinder。
items.author_line: Alan Nadelsticher Ruvalcaba, Chris Alvin, Supratik Mukhopadhyay, Adam Bess

items.title: Learning inhibitor interactions from protein deep mutational scanning data and deep learning models
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in protein language models, geometric deep learning, and structure prediction frameworks have the potential to accelerate computational drug discovery. However, it remains unclear how well these methods generalize beyond their training sets. Mutation-dependent drug responses present a challenge to these methods because there are often large effects from relatively small perturbations. Here, we systematically benchmark diverse mutational effect and drug-target affinity prediction models using deep mutational scanning datasets spanning 11 inhibitor conditions for the MET kinase domain. Across both mutational effect prediction and drug-target affinity tasks, current AI models produce largely ligand-invariant predictions despite experimentally distinct inhibitor-dependent fitness landscapes. Ligand-aware geometric models, including LigandMPNN and LASErMPNN, partially recover experimentally validated resistance-associated hotspots, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling protein-ligand interactions and local structural flexibility. In contrast, deep learning affinity prediction models underestimate mutation-induced changes in binding affinity. This deficiency likely reflects mutation-invariant structural priors derived from co-folded structure prediction frameworks and the absence of mutation-conditioned supervision in current affinity datasets. Finally, we further extended our analysis to several kinase-inhibitor deep mutational scanning datasets and confirm the overall trends. Our findings suggest that a primary limitation in improving performance on this task lies in the scarcity of mutation-conditioned protein-ligand training data rather than model architecture alone.
items.summary_zh: 研究利用覆盖 MET kinase domain 11 种抑制剂条件的深度突变扫描数据，基准测试突变效应和药物—靶标亲和力预测模型。现有模型大多给出与配体无关的预测；LigandMPNN 和 LASErMPNN 等配体感知几何模型能部分恢复实验验证的耐药热点，但亲和力模型仍低估突变导致的结合变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究以实验上不同的抑制剂依赖适应度景观揭示药物发现模型的关键盲点，强调突变条件化蛋白—配体数据的稀缺。范围集中于 MET 及若干激酶—抑制剂数据集，结论向其他靶标类别外推时应谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型、几何深度学习和结构预测框架的近期进展有望加速计算药物发现。然而，这些方法在其训练集之外的泛化能力仍不清楚。突变依赖的药物响应给这些方法带来挑战，因为相对微小的扰动常会产生很大的影响。在此，我们利用覆盖 MET kinase domain 11 种抑制剂条件的深度突变扫描数据集，系统性基准测试多种突变效应和药物—靶标亲和力预测模型。在突变效应预测和药物—靶标亲和力任务中，当前 AI 模型尽管面对实验上不同的抑制剂依赖适应度景观，却大多产生与配体无关的预测。包括 LigandMPNN 和 LASErMPNN 在内的配体感知几何模型可部分恢复经实验验证的耐药相关热点，凸显了显式建模蛋白质—配体相互作用和局部结构柔性的必要性。相比之下，深度学习亲和力预测模型低估了突变诱导的结合亲和力变化。这一缺陷很可能反映出：来自共折叠结构预测框架的突变不变结构先验，以及当前亲和力数据集中缺少突变条件化监督。最后，我们将分析扩展至若干激酶—抑制剂深度突变扫描数据集，并确认总体趋势。我们的发现表明，提升该任务性能的主要限制在于突变条件化蛋白质—配体训练数据的稀缺，而非仅仅是模型架构。
items.author_line: Zou, Z., Hazelwood, I., Estevam, G., Rao, J., Chrispens, K., Howard, M. K., Coyote-Maestas, W., Fraser, J. S.

review.note: 入选项目优先覆盖肽药、反应探索、口袋表征和药物耐药建模；均为预印本，结论仍需后续独立复现与实验验证。
